test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "begin to become."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The phrase **"begin to become"** would be suitable in the blank as we want to convey the idea that individuals start the process of transformation or development into leaders at the specific moment when they make independent decisions about how they want to be.
 
• It suggests a transition or initiation into a state of becoming a leader.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph:

By the time__ we reach puberty, the world has reached us and __shaped__ us to a greater extent than we realize. __Our__ family, friends, school, and society in general __have told us__ by word and example how to be. But people __**begin to become**__ leaders at that moment when they decide for themselves how to be.
